text:
Noah: Ran into a confusing quickstart failure during onboarding. The sample app prints a few streamed tokens then the client throws an error and the UI shows "permission_denied".
Zoe: Can you paste minimal repro? SDK and sample?
Noah: Using redwood-python 0.9.3 + starter-chat. Repro: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/chat/generate?stream=true" -d '{"input":"hey"}'` -> gets a couple of SSE chunks then `{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"attach a payment method to continue streaming"}}`.
onboard-bot: FYI: workspace 'acme-onboard' trial expired 2 days ago. Streaming is restricted until billing is added: https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/acme-onboard/billing
Noah: The odd part is the CLI surfaced it as permission_denied which confused the user during the demo.
CLI-bot: Logged: initial response 200 OK then a later control chunk with 402 Payment Required and header `x-rw-reason: billing_required`. Some gateways send the accept handshake first, then insert a control error.
mika: Two places to fix: (1) don't map billing_required into generic permission_denied in CLI/SDK; (2) add an optional preflight check `GET /v1/orgs/me/billing_status` before opening SSE/WS so apps don't show partial output.
Zoe: For immediate workaround I switched demos to `stream=false` so the 402 surfaces right away. Also added a one-line quickstart note about prechecking billing for streaming.
mika: Filing DX ticket RD-5001 to add the billing precheck to stream clients and update error mapping + retry policy (no retries on 402).
Noah: Thanks. Leaving the curl + captured SSE chunks in case infra wants to triage proxy ordering.
CLI-bot: Note: we'll backport a CLI patch to show raw billing error body until the mapping change lands.
mika: Also adding a small SDK change to emit a single `error` event on billing_required instead of streaming partial chunks into the app.
Zoe: Great—that should make onboarding demos less confusing. Closing this thread once RD-5001 lands.
